title: QMAP geology of the Christchurch area, 2008
credit: P. J. Forsyth, D. J. A. Barrell and R. Jongens (compilers); GNS Science
altText: Colour geological QMAP sheet and legend for Canterbury and Christchurch.
caption: GNS Science QMAP 1:250,000 geological map of the Christchurch area, compiled by Forsyth, Barrell and Jongens in 2008.
context: Example of national-scale digital geological mapping with detailed lithology and stratigraphic interpretation. The large original should be available at full resolution for reading its legend.
